n: Raspberry Pi Moving from Scratch to Python course
t: A free online course that helps educators move learners from Scratch to Python.
steps: Find the Moving from Scratch to Python course on the Raspberry Pi Foundation Training Hub.
Ask IT to review the Training Hub login and privacy terms.
Create a free Training Hub login.
Open Scratch 3 and the online Code Editor in a browser.
Plan 3 to 6 hours across several days.
